package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
)

const (
	materialsRootLessonID      = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
	materialsGoLessonID        = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
	materialsPythonLessonID    = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
	materialsRootExampleID     = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011"
	materialsInactiveExampleID = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012"
	materialsGoExampleID       = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000013"
	materialsPythonExampleID   = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000014"
	materialsRootTaskID        = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021"
	materialsInactiveTaskID    = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000022"
	materialsGoTaskID          = "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000023"
)

func TestGetLessonMaterialsAggregatesActiveStackContent(t *testing.T) {
	goStack := "go"
	pythonStack := "python"
	lessons := &materialsLessonRepository{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		materialsRootLessonID:   {ID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
		materialsGoLessonID:     {ID: materialsGoLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
		materialsPythonLessonID: {ID: materialsPythonLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive},
	}}
	examples := &materialsExampleRepository{byLesson: map[string][]domain.LessonExample{
		materialsRootLessonID: {
			{ID: materialsRootExampleID, LessonID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive, Stacks: []string{"neutral"}},
			{ID: materialsInactiveExampleID, LessonID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusInactive, Stacks: []string{"neutral"}},
		},
		materialsGoLessonID: {
			{ID: materialsGoExampleID, LessonID: materialsGoLessonID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive, PrimaryStack: &goStack, Stacks: []string{"go"}},
			{ID: materialsPythonExampleID, LessonID: materialsGoLessonID, Status: domain.LessonExampleStatusActive, PrimaryStack: &pythonStack, Stacks: []string{"python"}},
		},
	}}
	tasks := &materialsTaskRepository{byLesson: map[string][]domain.Task{
		materialsRootLessonID: {
			{ID: materialsRootTaskID, LessonID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive},
			{ID: materialsInactiveTaskID, LessonID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.TaskStatusNoActive},
		},
		materialsGoLessonID: {{ID: materialsGoTaskID, LessonID: materialsGoLessonID, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive}},
	}}
	tests := &materialsTaskTestRepository{byTask: map[string][]domain.TaskTest{
		materialsRootTaskID: {{ID: "test-root", TaskID: materialsRootTaskID}},
		materialsGoTaskID:   {{ID: "test-go", TaskID: materialsGoTaskID}},
	}}
	lessonRelations := &materialsLessonRelationRepository{byLesson: map[string][]domain.LessonRelation{
		materialsRootLessonID: {
			{ID: "relation-go", TargetLessonID: materialsGoLessonID, PrimaryStack: &goStack, Stacks: []string{"go"}},
			{ID: "relation-python", TargetLessonID: materialsPythonLessonID, PrimaryStack: &pythonStack, Stacks: []string{"python"}},
		},
	}}
	exampleRelations := &materialsExampleRelationRepository{byExample: map[string][]domain.LessonExampleRelation{
		materialsRootExampleID: {
			{ID: "example-relation-go", TargetExampleID: materialsGoExampleID, PrimaryStack: "go", Stacks: []string{"go"}},
			{ID: "example-relation-python", TargetExampleID: materialsPythonExampleID, PrimaryStack: "python", Stacks: []string{"python"}},
		},
	}}

	result, err := (GetLessonMaterials{
		Lessons:          lessons,
		LessonRelations:  lessonRelations,
		Examples:         examples,
		ExampleRelations: exampleRelations,
		Tasks:            tasks,
		TaskTests:        tests,
		Access:           contentaccess.Service{Repository: materialsContentAccessRepository{}},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), materialsRootLessonID, "go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get lesson materials: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Stack != "go" || len(result.Examples) != 1 || len(result.Tasks) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected root materials: %#v", result)
	}
	if len(result.Tasks[0].Tests) != 1 || result.Tasks[0].Tests[0].ID != "test-root" {
		t.Fatalf("root task tests were not loaded: %#v", result.Tasks)
	}
	if len(result.RelatedLessons) != 1 || result.RelatedLessons[0].Relation.ID != "relation-go" {
		t.Fatalf("stack filter did not select Go lesson: %#v", result.RelatedLessons)
	}
	if len(result.RelatedLessons[0].Examples) != 1 || result.RelatedLessons[0].Examples[0].ID != materialsGoExampleID {
		t.Fatalf("related lesson examples were not stack-filtered: %#v", result.RelatedLessons[0].Examples)
	}
	if len(result.RelatedLessons[0].Tasks) != 1 || len(result.RelatedLessons[0].Tasks[0].Tests) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("related lesson tasks/tests were not loaded: %#v", result.RelatedLessons[0].Tasks)
	}
	if len(result.RelatedExamples) != 1 || result.RelatedExamples[0].Example.ID != materialsGoExampleID {
		t.Fatalf("stack filter did not select Go example: %#v", result.RelatedExamples)
	}
}

func TestGetLessonMaterialsRejectsInvalidStackAndInactiveRoot(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &materialsLessonRepository{lessons: map[string]domain.Lesson{
		materialsRootLessonID: {ID: materialsRootLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusNoActive},
	}}
	uc := GetLessonMaterials{
		Lessons:          repository,
		LessonRelations:  &materialsLessonRelationRepository{},
		Examples:         &materialsExampleRepository{},
		ExampleRelations: &materialsExampleRelationRepository{},
		Tasks:            &materialsTaskRepository{},
		TaskTests:        &materialsTaskTestRepository{},
		Access:           contentaccess.Service{Repository: materialsContentAccessRepository{}},
	}
	if _, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), materialsRootLessonID, "Go Script"); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("invalid stack error = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), materialsRootLessonID, ""); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("inactive root error = %v", err)
	}
}

type materialsLessonRepository struct {
	lessons map[string]domain.Lesson
}

func (*materialsLessonRepository) Create(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (r *materialsLessonRepository) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	item, ok := r.lessons[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &item, nil
}
func (r *materialsLessonRepository) GetWithFields(_ context.Context, id string, _ queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	if _, ok := r.lessons[id]; !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return map[string]any{"id": id, "status": r.lessons[id].Status}, nil
}
func (*materialsLessonRepository) Update(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (*materialsLessonRepository) Delete(context.Context, string) error        { return nil }
func (*materialsLessonRepository) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (*materialsLessonRepository) ListByCourseFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.LessonFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil
}
func (*materialsLessonRepository) ListBySection(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

type materialsLessonRelationRepository struct {
	byLesson map[string][]domain.LessonRelation
}

func (*materialsLessonRelationRepository) ReplaceBySourceLesson(context.Context, string, []domain.LessonRelation) error {
	return nil
}
func (r *materialsLessonRelationRepository) ListBySourceLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error) {
	return r.byLesson[lessonID], nil
}
func (*materialsLessonRelationRepository) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

type materialsExampleRepository struct {
	byLesson map[string][]domain.LessonExample
}

func (*materialsExampleRepository) ReplaceByLesson(context.Context, string, []domain.LessonExample) error {
	return nil
}
func (r *materialsExampleRepository) Get(_ context.Context, exampleID string) (*domain.LessonExample, error) {
	for _, items := range r.byLesson {
		for _, item := range items {
			if item.ID == exampleID {
				copy := item
				return &copy, nil
			}
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *materialsExampleRepository) ListByLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string, _ bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	return r.byLesson[lessonID], nil
}
func (*materialsExampleRepository) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

type materialsExampleRelationRepository struct {
	byExample map[string][]domain.LessonExampleRelation
}

func (*materialsExampleRelationRepository) ReplaceBySourceExample(context.Context, string, []domain.LessonExampleRelation) error {
	return nil
}
func (r *materialsExampleRelationRepository) ListBySourceExample(_ context.Context, exampleID string, _ bool) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error) {
	return r.byExample[exampleID], nil
}
func (*materialsExampleRelationRepository) Delete(context.Context, string) error { return nil }

func (*materialsTaskRepository) Create(context.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (*materialsTaskRepository) Update(context.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (*materialsTaskRepository) Delete(context.Context, string) error      { return nil }
func (*materialsTaskRepository) Get(context.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (*materialsTaskRepository) GetWithFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound

func (r *materialsTaskRepository) ListByLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return r.byLesson[lessonID], nil

func (*materialsTaskRepository) ListByLessonFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.TaskFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil

	return nil
